name: Validate Pre-Harvest Interval
script:
# Validate Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) compliance before harvest
import frappe
from frappe import _
from frappe.utils import getdate, date_diff

if doc.crop_project and doc.field:
	# Get last spray operation for this field
	spray_logs = frappe.get_all("Field Operation Log",
		filters={
			"field": doc.field,
			"crop_project": doc.crop_project,
			"operation_type": "Spraying",
			"docstatus": 1
		},
		fields=["name", "operation_date", "pre_harvest_interval_days"],
		order_by="operation_date desc",
		limit=1
	)
	
	if spray_logs:
		last_spray = spray_logs[0]
		if last_spray.pre_harvest_interval_days:
			phi_days = last_spray.pre_harvest_interval_days
			days_since_spray = date_diff(doc.harvest_date, last_spray.operation_date)
			
			if days_since_spray < phi_days:
				error_msg = f"Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) violation! Last spray: {last_spray.operation_date}, PHI Required: {phi_days} days, Days since spray: {days_since_spray}. Cannot harvest before PHI period expires for food safety compliance."
				frappe.throw(_(error_msg))
